review_scope: conceptual NexusBoard MCP architecture; no live security audit
source_title: NexusBoard Architectural Security Audit: Federation Resilience, Identity Boundary Enforcement, and Provenance Memory

controls.requirement: Every receiving office independently authenticates and authorizes delegated call
controls.evidence_required: Gateway and seat auth middleware; denial evidence; policy versions
controls.challenging_observation: gateway-only policy or child accepting arbitrary caller_seat
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: No authority laundering via executive gateway
controls.evidence_required: Signed or otherwise verified delegation and scope chain; policy intersection and refusal logs
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: Allowed peer edges are per-capability/mission, not full mesh
controls.evidence_required: Versioned allowlists; deny-by-default routes; actual service registry
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: No proposer self-grants roles or SQL privileges
controls.evidence_required: Protected admin provisioning; independent approval; no runtime admin creds
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: Effective least-privilege and row policy checks independent of model
controls.evidence_required: Actual grants, RLS predicates, owner/BYPASSRLS review, safe transaction context
controls.challenging_observation: owner credential in Agent, spoofable app settings as sole auth
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: Async interleaving and cross-seat updates remain safe
controls.evidence_required: Atomic state transitions, transaction design, idempotency and locking
controls.challenging_observation: concurrent task losses or inconsistent checkpoints
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: Provenance and audit trace are protected and independently reviewable
controls.evidence_required: Write/read separation, append-only policies, external integrity anchor and retention design
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: Entity/Activity/Agent and derivations are attributable but not overclaimed
controls.evidence_required: Explicit schema mapping, actual source hash rules and provenance bundles
controls.challenging_observation: PROV-O labeling treated as proof of immutability
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: Revocable leases and machine mandates preserve mission continuity
controls.evidence_required: Credential issuer/audience/scope/expiry, versioned checkpoint, job fencing
controls.challenging_observation: stale lease accepted or duplicate external effect
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: Accepted relations and protected changes require competent, version-correct disposition
controls.evidence_required: Authenticated decision, approval path, conflict and revocation handling
controls.challenging_observation: accepted record only has unsigned/invalid approval ID
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: Independent examiner cannot self-implement its remediation
controls.evidence_required: Read-only scoped principal, immutable evidence refs, review trail
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: Alerts and circuit breakers are authorized and false-positive-resilient
controls.evidence_required: Approved triggers, impact limits, rollback, incident reports and consent
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references

controls.requirement: Tool success never alone establishes factual approval or outcome
controls.challenging_observation: HTTP 200 promotes knowledge truth or payout
controls.source: owner-provided security report plus cited technical references
